approval_statement: Continue the experiment through statistical confirmation. V5 applies the smallest data-integrity repair: lower the LID-DS-2021 confirmatory content cap and its four matching allocation counts from 45 to 44, preserving phase disjointness, all other frozen protocol values, and the previously authorized maximum of 440 CPU-h.
limitations: This V5 approval changes only the LID-DS-2021 confirmatory cap/count from 45 to 44 after the V4 preflight found 44 content-unique valid validation recordings in one scenario.
Confirmatory execution remains prohibited if fresh V5 pilot/preflight, support, leakage, truth-lock, artifact-integrity, and total-cost gates do not pass.
The maximum authorized computation remains 440 CPU-h; no over-budget execution is authorized.

The frozen statistical protocol reports uncertainty only where its cluster and stochastic-design assumptions are met; it does not turn deterministic-versus-stochastic descriptive contrasts or HAI two-cluster results into unsupported significance claims.
